title: Card Battler
observed_goal: The page text and official card claim a strategic card game based on deck building, unit deployment, and spell combinations; in the frames, only the goal of entering the game through the main menu is visible, and the in-battle objective was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
observed_controls: In the late frame, the interface text shows selection with the up/down keys and confirmation with Enter; this is a direct observation of the menu guide, not proof of a successful in-game control test.
The text buttons START GAME, MULTIPLAYER, LEADERBOARD, and SETTINGS are visible in the menu frames; the function of each was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
In the metadata, a canvas-center click and several keyboard inputs are recorded, but acceptance of these inputs cannot be established from the image change.
Effective input for battling, card selection, unit deployment, or spell casting was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
observed_core_loop: The active game loop, turns, card drawing, selection/deployment, combination, conflict resolution, or repetition of these was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. The only observable path is from loading to the main menu.
progress_feedback: In the load, after_start, and after_key_burst frames, loading percentages of 0%, 4%, and 74% are visible, respectively; this is loading feedback, not game progress. The main menu is visible in the after_combined_input and late frames, and no battle-progress indicator was observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
decisions_risk_reward: Actual player decisions, choice costs, risk/reward, resources, targeting, or timing were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. The official card claims tactics and timely combinations, but this was not playtested.
rewards: In-game rewards, score, rank, cards, resources, or success messages were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. The presence of the LEADERBOARD button in the menu frame alone does not establish the rank value or logic.
penalties_failure: Failure, damage, resource loss, end of turn, or error messages in the game were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
outcomes_replay: Win, loss, direct outcome, end screen, or replay path was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive. Differences between frames alone do not prove accepted input or a repeatable loop.
onboarding: Loading is visible with the title Trading Card Game Template and a percentage bar. Afterward, the main menu with START GAME is visible; a tutorial, rules explanation, sample hand, or battle guide was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
visual_audio_accessibility: The frames show an interface with bright contrast on a dark background, large buttons, and a textual control guide in the late frame. The languages EN / 中文 are visible in the late frame. Audio, accessibility settings, text size, adjustable contrast, and alternative-input support were not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
technical_clues: The metadata records the console with Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official; this is a technical clue and does not establish the game mechanics.
The metadata reports WebGL 2.0 / OpenGL ES 3.0 running on Emscripten 4.0.20 and single-threaded mode; these are runtime specifications, not evidence of a game loop.
Two WebGL software fallback warnings and one 403 response error were recorded in the console; their effect on the game experience was not observed; the available evidence is inconclusive.
The metadata says engine markers and tuning constant candidates are empty and the game scripts were not scanned; conclusions about the internal logic are not possible.
transferable_principles: Staged loading feedback followed by a clear entry point makes the start of the experience understandable; the final mechanics must be tested separately.
Display menu controls briefly and explicitly so that selection and confirmation require no guesswork.
Treat strategic decisions as evaluable only when their cost, consequence, and outcome are observable in the complete loop.
Create a clear visual and semantic distinction between technical-progress feedback, game progress, and the final outcome.
candle_climber_relevance: For Candle Climber, every score or rank should reflect skill and performance only, not purchases or a wallet, and not a paid advantage.
The principle of brief guidance and clear feedback can be used for starting and confirming, without reproducing this game's text, appearance, or assets.

These findings support no conclusion about adding free brake, changing horizontal direction, or introducing a branching path requiring new controls; each is only a hypothesis requiring independent testing.
The Candle Climber loop should be evaluated using direct evidence of movement, decision, and outcome; a change between two frames or loading progress alone is insufficient.
do_not_copy: Do not reproduce the names, characters, illustrations, setting, art style, or any specific asset of this sample.
Do not copy the sample's text, labels, or menu layout verbatim.
Do not treat claims of deck building, deployment, combination, or any unverified mechanic as an implemented reality.
Do not turn temporal/image changes between frames into claims of input acceptance, winning, losing, or a game loop.

evidence.claim: The load frame shows a loading page with the title Trading Card Game Template and a value of 0%.
The after_start frame shows the same loading page with a value of 4%.
The after_key_burst frame shows the same loading page with a value of 74%; this change alone does not establish key acceptance.
The after_combined_input frame shows the main menu with START GAME and MULTIPLAYER.
The late frame shows the main menu with START GAME, MULTIPLAYER, LEADERBOARD, SETTINGS, and the SELECT/ENTER guide.
The official card describes the experience as a strategic card battler based on deck building, unit deployment, and spell combinations.
The recorded page text reports the title Trading Card Game Template and loading percentages of 0%, 2%, and 74%.
The console reports Godot 4.7.2, WebGL 2.0/OpenGL ES 3.0, and Emscripten 4.0.20.
The image change may result from animation or the passage of time and does not establish that the inputs were understood.

limitations: This analysis uses only evidence.json and the frames of this game; no web browsing or rerun was performed. The frames show up to the main menu and do not confirm any battle loop, outcome, audio, or in-game control behavior. The absence of an element in the opening frame or menu does not establish its absence from the game as a whole. source_gallery_url is empty in the metadata; therefore, source_url was kept empty for the official-card claim.
